articles.summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. ("Peoples") (NASDAQ: PEBO) today announced results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. Net income totaled $28.0 million for the second quarter of 2026, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.78. In comparison, Peoples reported net income of $29.0 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.81, for the first quarter of 2026 and net income of $21.2 million, representing earnings per diluted common share of $0.59, for the second quarter of 2025.
articles.title: PEOPLES BANCORP INC. ANNOUNCES RESULTS FOR THE SECOND QUARTER 2026
